For the consideration of these expenses, the following applies:
a) For a one-way distance between the residence and the place of work of up to 20 km, these expenses are generally compensated by the transport tax credit (Section 33(5) and Section 57(3)).
b) If the one-way distance between the residence and the place of work predominantly travelled by the employee during the pay period exceeds 20 km and the use of public transport is reasonable, the following additional flat-rate amounts shall be taken into account:
c) If, during the pay period, the use of public transport between the residence and the place of work is predominantly not reasonable for the employee at least with regard to half of the distance, the following flat-rate amounts shall be taken into account instead of the flat-rate amounts under lit. b:
152.
